statement: General exact mapping property. For every valid invocation with width W, height H, pitch P with P >= W, integer shiftX and shiftY, a row-major source buffer S of W*H binary32 elements, and a writable output buffer O of H*P binary32 elements, the candidate must make the predicate true for all integer x in [0,W) and y in [0,H): O[y*P + x] equals S[floor_mod(y + shiftY, H) * W + floor_mod(x + shiftX, W)] by exact binary32 bit equality, where floor_mod(k, n) = ((k mod n) + n) mod n.
